# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> No. 3 Bay View Cottage is an end of terrace 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom, 950 sq. ft. property with sea view built in 2000 and centrally located in the charming coastal village of Kilcrohane on the Sheep's Head Peninsula in south west Cork. Option to purchase contents. LOCATION: The property is conveniently situated only a stone's throw from a shop, post office, bar and 2 restaurants.
